name: Lowe's
description: Lowe's is the second-largest US home improvement retailer: 1,759 stores and outlets with about 196 million square feet of selling space, plus over 540 branch locations that deliver building materials to larger Pro customers. It sells appliances, flooring, paint, lumber, tools, hardware and outdoor goods to do-it-yourself homeowners, do-it-for-me projects and Pro contractors, in store, online and with installation services; it earns the retail margin on merchandise, so sales follow home-repair and remodelling activity, housing turnover and home prices. In FY2025 it bought Foundation Building Materials (FBM, $8.8B cash, 2025-10-09) and Artisan Design Group (ADG) to reach larger Pro customers, which form a new 'Other' segment ($2.2B of FY2025 sales) and were financed with $5.0B of new notes and a $2.0B term loan.

sub.name: Home improvement, building products and timber

employees.note: Approximately 167,000 full-time and 109,000 part-time associates (sum computed), primarily in the US and India.

businessLines.name: Retail Home Improvement
businessLines.how: Earns the retail margin selling building materials, décor, tools and hardware through stores and online to DIY and Pro customers, with some installation services; transaction-by-transaction, seasonal (spring and summer highest). Sales depend on housing turnover, home price appreciation and remodelling demand.

businessLines.name: Other (FBM and ADG, acquired 2025)
businessLines.how: FBM distributes drywall, ceilings and interior building materials to large residential and commercial contractors, and ADG provides interior finishing products and installation for homebuilders; sold on contract and project volume to builders, driven by construction activity. Included from the acquisition dates only.

brands.name: Foundation Building Materials (FBM)
brands.note: Acquired 2025-10-09 for $8.8 billion cash; specialty distributor of interior building materials; over 540 branch locations across Lowe's Pro network include FBM branches.

brands.name: Retail home improvement: 1,759 stores and outlets
brands.note: Average about 112,000 sq ft selling space plus about 32,000 sq ft of outdoor garden centre; United States only (plus branch locations in US and Canada).
